verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show an interactive API explorer with runnable examples on Adyen's docs. The closest support is the official OpenAPI spec repository, described as the 'single source of truth' and usable to create Postman collections. That gives runnable requests only through an extra tool. The machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) help with exploration but are not interactive or runnable, and probes found no OpenAPI file served from docs.adyen.com. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API reference/explorer, in-browser runnable examples or try-it consoles, and hands-on corroboration of a runnable reference experience.
